detail.q: Milvus 能否在无外网的环境下部署？
detail.answer: 可以。Milvus 可在离线环境中安装 [1]。

blocks.title: Can I deploy Milvus when disconnected from the Internet?
blocks.text: Can I deploy Milvus when disconnected from the Internet? Yes. You can install Milvus in an offline environment. See Install Milvus Offline for more information.

detail.q: 多个 Milvus 实例可以共用一个 MinIO 实例吗？
detail.answer: 可以，多个 Milvus 实例可以共用一个 MinIO 实例 [1]。为此，需要在启动前将每个 Milvus 实例配置文件中的 minio.rootPath 改为唯一值 [1]。

blocks.title: Can I share a MinIO instance among multiple Milvus instances
blocks.text: Can I share a MinIO instance among multiple Milvus instances? Yes, you can share a MinIO instance among multiple Milvus instances. To do so, you need to change minio.rootPath to a unique value for each Milvus instance in the configuration files of each before starting them.

detail.q: 多个 Milvus 实例可以共用一个 etcd 实例吗？
detail.answer: 可以，多个 Milvus 实例可以共用一个 etcd 实例 [1]。为此，需要在启动前在每个 Milvus 实例的配置文件中将 etcd.rootPath 改为各自不同的值 [1]。

blocks.title: Can I share an etcd instance among multiple Milvus instances
blocks.text: Can I share an etcd instance among multiple Milvus instances? Yes, you can share an etcd instance among multiple Milvus instances. To do so, you need to change etcd.rootPath to a separate value for each Milvus instance in the configuration files of each before starting them.

detail.q: Milvus 可以在 Windows 上安装吗？
detail.answer: 可以。可以通过从源代码编译或从二进制包安装的方式在 Windows 上安装 Milvus [1]。

blocks.title: Can I install Milvus on Windows?
blocks.text: Can I install Milvus on Windows? Yes. You can install Milvus on Windows either by compiling from source code or from a binary package. See Run Milvus on Windows to learn how to install Milvus on Windows.

detail.q: 怎么判断 Milvus 是否已经成功启动？
detail.answer: 如果使用 Docker Compose 启动 Milvus，运行 docker ps 观察有多少 Docker 容器在运行，并检查 Milvus 服务是否正确启动 [4]。对于 Milvus standalone，应至少能看到三个运行中的 Docker 容器，一个是 Milvus 服务，另外两个是 etcd 管理和存储服务 [4]。

blocks.title: How do I know if Milvus has started successfully?
blocks.text: How do I know if Milvus has started successfully? If Milvus is started using Docker Compose, run docker ps to observe how many Docker containers are running and check if Milvus services started correctly. For Milvus standalone, you should be able to observe at least three running Docker containers, one being the Milvus service and the other two being etcd management and storage service. For more information, see Installing Milvus Standalone.

detail.q: 为什么我修改了配置文件却不生效？
detail.answer: Milvus 不支持在运行时修改配置文件，必须重启 Milvus Docker 才能使配置文件更改生效 [4]。

detail.q: 哪些因素会影响检索的召回率？
detail.answer: 召回率主要受索引类型和搜索参数影响 [7]。对于 IVF 索引，nprobe 参数决定搜索范围，增大 nprobe 会提高召回率，但会降低查询性能 [7]。对于 HNSW 索引，ef 参数决定图搜索广度，增大 ef 会提高召回率，但会降低查询性能 [7]。对于 FLAT 索引，Milvus 在集合内进行穷举扫描，返回率为 100% [7]。

blocks.title: What are the main factors affecting recall?
blocks.text: What are the main factors affecting recall? Recall is affected mainly by index type and search parameters. For FLAT index, Milvus takes an exhaustive scan within a collection, with a 100% return. For IVF indexes, the nprobe parameter determines the scope of a search within the collection. Increasing nprobe increases the proportion of vectors searched and recall, but diminishes query performance. For HNSW index, the ef parameter determines the breadth of the graph search. Increasing ef increases the number of points searched on the graph and recall, but diminishes query performance. For more in

detail.q: Milvus 运行日志存放在哪里？
detail.answer: Milvus 日志默认打印到标准输出（stdout）和标准错误（stderr）[16]。生产环境建议将日志重定向到持久化卷，可通过修改 milvus.yaml 中的 log.file.rootPath 实现[16]。若使用 milvus-helm chart 部署，还需先通过 --set log.persistence.enabled=true 启用日志持久化[16]。

blocks.title: Where can I find the logs generated by Milvus?
blocks.text: Where can I find the logs generated by Milvus? The Milvus log is printed to stout (standard output) and stderr (standard error) by default, however we highly recommend redirecting your log to a persistent volume in production. To do so, update log.file.rootPath in milvus.yaml. And if you deploy Milvus with milvus-helm chart, you also need to enable log persistence first via --set log.persistence.enabled=true. If you didn't change the config, using kubectl logs

detail.q: Milvus 的主键字段支持哪些数据类型？
detail.answer: Milvus 当前版本的主键字段支持 INT64 和 string 两种数据类型 [1]。

blocks.title: What data types does Milvus support on the primary key field
blocks.text: What data types does Milvus support on the primary key field? In current release, Milvus supports both INT64 and string.

detail.q: Milvus 支持的最大向量维度是多少？
detail.answer: Milvus 默认支持的最大向量维度为 32,768 [1]。

blocks.title: What is the maximum vector dimension supported in Milvus?
blocks.text: What is the maximum vector dimension supported in Milvus? Milvus can manage vectors with up to 32,768 dimensions by default. You can increase the value of Proxy.maxDimension to allow for a larger dimension vector.

detail.q: Milvus 里 search 和 query 有什么区别？
detail.answer: 在 Milvus 中，向量相似度搜索基于相似度计算和向量索引加速来检索向量 [1]。与向量相似度搜索不同，向量查询通过基于布尔表达式的标量过滤来检索向量 [1]。布尔表达式对标量字段或主键字段进行过滤，并检索所有匹配过滤条件的结果 [1]。在查询中，既不涉及相似度度量，也不涉及向量索引 [1]。

blocks.title: What's the difference between a search and a query?
blocks.text: What's the difference between a search and a query? In Milvus, a vector similarity search retrieves vectors based on similarity calculation and vector index acceleration. Unlike a vector similarity search, a vector query retrieves vectors via scalar filtering based on a boolean expression. The boolean expression filters on scalar fields or the primary key field, and it retrieves all results that match the filters. In a query, neither similarity metrics nor vector index is involved.

detail.q: 插入数据之后还能再创建索引吗？
detail.answer: 可以。如果之前已经通过 create_index() 为 collection 建立过索引，Milvus 会自动为后续插入的向量构建索引 [7]。但 Milvus 会等到新插入的向量填满整个 segment 后才构建索引，且新创建的索引文件与之前的索引文件是分开的 [7]。

blocks.title: Can indexes be created after inserting vectors?
blocks.text: Product FAQ -> Can indexes be created after inserting vectors? Yes. If an index has been built for a collection by create_index() before, Milvus will automatically build an index for subsequently inserted vectors. However, Milvus does not build an index until the newly inserted vectors fill an entire segment and the newly created index file is separate from the previous one.

detail.q: Milvus 支持并发搜索吗？
detail.answer: 是的。对于同一集合的查询，Milvus 会并发搜索增量数据和历史数据；但不同集合的查询是串行执行的 [13]。

blocks.title: Is Milvus available for concurrent search?
blocks.text: Is Milvus available for concurrent search? Yes. For queries on the same collection, Milvus concurrently searches the incremental and historical data. However, queries on different collections are conducted in series. Whereas the historical data can be an extremely huge dataset, searches on the historical data are relatively more time-consuming and essentially performed in series.

detail.q: Milvus 的数据存储在哪里？
detail.answer: 插入数据（包括向量数据、标量数据和集合特定 schema）以增量日志形式存储在持久化存储中，支持多种对象存储后端，包括 MinIO、AWS S3、Google Cloud Storage (GCS)、Azure Blob Storage、阿里云 OSS 和腾讯云 COS [1]。元数据由 Milvus 各模块生成，存储在 etcd 中 [1]。

blocks.title: Where does Milvus store data?
blocks.text: Product FAQ -> Where does Milvus store data? Milvus deals with two types of data, inserted data and metadata. Inserted data, including vector data, scalar data, and collection-specific schema, are stored in persistent storage as incremental log. Milvus supports multiple object storage backends, including MinIO, AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Azure Blob Storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS, and Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS). Metadata are generated within Milvus. Each Milvus module has its own metadata that are stored in etcd.

detail.q: 为什么欧氏距离和內积检索返回的结果不一样？
detail.answer: 对于归一化向量，欧氏距离（L2）在数学上等价于内积（IP）[7]。如果这两种相似度度量返回不同结果，应检查向量是否已归一化 [7]。

blocks.title: Why do Euclidean distance (L2) and inner product (IP) return
blocks.text: Product FAQ -> Why do Euclidean distance (L2) and inner product (IP) return different results? For normalized vectors, Euclidean distance (L2) is mathematically equivalent to inner product (IP). If these similarity metrics return different results, check to see if your vectors are normalized

detail.q: 为什么搜索 topk 时返回的结果少于 k 个？
detail.answer: 在 Milvus 支持的索引中，IVF_FLAT 和 IVF_SQ8 实现 k-means 聚类方法，数据空间被划分为 nlist 个簇，插入的向量被分配到这些簇中，Milvus 随后选择 nprobe 个最近的簇，并比较目标向量与所选簇中所有向量的距离以返回最终结果 [1]。如果 nlist 和 topk 较大而 nprobe 较小，nprobe 个簇中的向量数量可能少于 k [1]。因此，当搜索 topk 个最近向量时，返回的向量数量少于 k [1]。为避免此问题，可尝试将 nprobe 设置得更大，将 nlist 和 k 设置得更小 [1]。

blocks.title: Why do I get fewer than k vectors when searching for topk ve
blocks.text: Why do I get fewer than k vectors when searching for topk vectors? Among the indexes that Milvus supports, IVF_FLAT and IVF_SQ8 implement the k-means clustering method. A data space is divided into nlist clusters and the inserted vectors are distributed to these clusters. Milvus then selects the nprobe nearest clusters and compares the distances between the target vector and all vectors in the selected clusters to return the final results. If nlist and topk are large and nprobe is small, the number of vectors in the nprobe clusters may be less than k. Therefore, when you search for the topk ne

detail.q: Milvus 支持 Apple M1 芯片吗？
detail.answer: 当前 Milvus 版本不支持 Apple M1 CPU [1]。Milvus 无法安装或运行在非 x86 平台上 [13]。

blocks.title: Does Milvus support Apple M1 CPU?
blocks.text: Does Milvus support Apple M1 CPU? Current Milvus release does not support Apple M1 CPU.

blocks.title: What data types does Milvus support on the primary key field
blocks.text: What data types does Milvus support on the primary key field? In current release, Milvus supports both INT64 and string.

detail.q: 集合删除后 MinIO 里的数据为什么还在？
detail.answer: MinIO 中的数据被设计为保留一段时间，以便于数据回滚 [1]。

blocks.title: Why does the data in MinIO remain after the corresponding co
blocks.text: Why does the data in MinIO remain after the corresponding collection is dropped? Data in MinIO is designed to remain for a certain period of time for the convenience of data rollback.

detail.q: FLAT 和 IVF_FLAT 索引有什么区别？
detail.answer: FLAT 直接比较目标向量与所有其他向量之间的距离 [1]。IVF_FLAT 将向量空间划分为 list 个簇，默认 list 值为 16,384，Milvus 先比较目标向量与所有簇质心的距离以返回最近的簇，再比较目标向量与所选簇内向量之间的距离以得到最近向量 [1]。当向量总数约等于 nlist 时，IVF_FLAT 与 FLAT 在计算需求和搜索性能上差异很小；但当向量数量超过 nlist 两倍或更多时，IVF_FLAT 开始表现出性能优势 [1]。

blocks.title: How are the FLAT and IVF_FLAT indexes different?
blocks.text: Product FAQ -> How are the FLAT and IVF_FLAT indexes different? The IVF_FLAT index divides vector space into list clusters. At the default list value of 16,384, Milvus compares the distances between the target vector and the centroids of all 16,384 clusters to return probe nearest clusters. Milvus then compares the distances between the target vector and the vectors in the selected clusters to get the nearest vectors. Unlike IVF_FLAT, FLAT directly compares the distances between the target vector and every other vector. When the total number of vectors approximately equals nlist, there is litt

detail.q: 同时进行数据插入和搜索会影响查询性能吗？
detail.answer: 会。插入操作本身不占 CPU，但新段可能未达到建索引阈值，Milvus 会退化为暴力搜索，从而显著影响查询性能 [1]。该阈值由 rootcoord.minSegmentSizeToEnableIndex 参数决定，默认 1024 行 [1]。

blocks.title: Does simultaneously inserting data and searching impact quer
blocks.text: Does simultaneously inserting data and searching impact query performance? Insert operations are not CPU intensive. However, because new segments may not have reached the threshold for index building, Milvus resorts to brute-force search—significantly impacting query performance. The rootcoord.minSegmentSizeToEnableIndex parameter determines the index-building threshold for a segment, and is set to 1024 rows by default. See System Configuration for more information.

detail.q: IVF 索引的 nlist 和 nprobe 应该怎么设置？
detail.answer: nlist 的设置与具体场景相关，经验法则是推荐值为 4 × sqrt(n)，其中 n 是段中实体总数 [1]。nprobe 的设置取决于数据集和场景，需要在准确率和查询性能之间权衡，建议通过反复实验找到理想值 [1]。如果 nlist 和 topk 较大而 nprobe 较小，nprobe 个聚类中的向量数可能少于 k，导致返回结果少于 topk，此时可尝试增大 nprobe、减小 nlist 和 k [4]。

blocks.title: How to set nlist and nprobe for IVF indexes?
blocks.text: Performance FAQ -> How to set nlist and nprobe for IVF indexes? Setting nlist is scenario-specific. As a rule of thumb, the recommended value of nlist is 4 × sqrt(n), where n is the total number of entities in a segment. The size of each segment is determined by the datacoord.segment.maxSize parameter, which is set to 512 MB by default. The total number of entities in a segment n can be estimated by dividing datacoord.segment.maxSize by the size of each entity. Setting nprobe is specific to the dataset and scenario, and involves a trade-off between accuracy and query performance. We recommend

A data space is divided into nlist clusters and the inserted vectors are distributed to these clusters. Milvus then selects the nprobe nearest clusters and compares the distances between the target vector and all vectors in the selected clusters to return the final results. If nlist and topk are large and nprobe is small, the number of vectors in the nprobe clusters may be less than k. Therefore, when you search for the topk ne

detail.q: 为什么在较小的数据集上查询有时反而更慢？
detail.answer: 查询操作在段（segment）上执行 [1]。索引可减少查询段所需时间 [1]。若段尚未建立索引，Milvus 会对原始数据采用暴力搜索，从而大幅增加查询时间 [1]。因此，较小数据集（collection）上的查询通常更慢，因为它尚未建立索引 [1]。这是因为其段大小尚未达到 rootCoord.minSegmentSizeToEnableindex 设置的索引构建阈值 [1]。调用 create_index() 可强制 Milvus 对已达到阈值但尚未自动索引的段建立索引，从而显著提升查询性能 [1]。

blocks.title: Why do queries sometimes take longer on smaller datasets?
blocks.text: Why do queries sometimes take longer on smaller datasets? Query operations are conducted on segments. indexes reduce the amount of time it takes to query a segment. If a segment has not been indexed, Milvus resorts to brute-force search on the raw data—drastically increasing query time. Therefore, it usually takes longer to query on a small dataset (collection) because it has not built index. This is because the sizes of its segments have not reached the index-building threshold set by rootCoord.minSegmentSizeToEnableindex. Call create_index() to force Milvus to index segments that have reache

detail.q: 哪些操作会导致 CPU 占用升高？
detail.answer: 构建索引或运行查询会导致 CPU 占用升高 [1]。构建索引通常是 CPU 密集型操作，但使用 Annoy 时除外，因为它是单线程运行的 [1]。运行查询时，CPU 占用受 nq 和 nprobe 影响；当 nq 和 nprobe 较小时，并发较低，CPU 占用保持较低 [1]。

blocks.title: What factors impact CPU usage?
blocks.text: What factors impact CPU usage? CPU usage increases when Milvus is building indexes or running queries. In general, index building is CPU intensive except when using Annoy, which runs on a single thread. When running queries, CPU usage is affected by nq and nprobe. When nq and nprobe are small, concurrency is low and CPU usage stays low.

detail.q: Milvus 支持哪些索引类型和相似度度量方式？
detail.answer: Milvus 支持多种索引类型，常见的有 HNSW 与 IVF 系列 [3][6]。HNSW 具有高召回率、内存占用较大的特点 [3][6]；IVF 内存友好，需要训练 [3][6]。若未指定索引类型，Milvus 默认执行暴力搜索 [1]。关于相似度度量方式，知识库中未找到依据。

blocks.title: What indexes and metrics are supported?
blocks.text: What indexes and metrics are supported? Indexes are an organization unit of data. You must declare the index type and similarity metric before you can search or query inserted entities. If you do not specify an index type, Milvus will operate brute-force search by default.

detail.q: 等离子体处理的基本原理是什么？
detail.answer: 等离子体是物质的第四种状态，由离子、电子、中性原子/分子以及自由基组成的电离气体 [1]。在半导体工艺中，等离子体处理通过物理轰击和化学反应双重机制改变材料表面特性 [1]。

blocks.title: 等离子体处理的基本原理与作用机制
blocks.text: 等离子体处理改善半导体材料表面特性的技术与方法 -> 等离子体处理的基本原理与作用机制 等离子体(Plasma)是物质的第四种状态，由离子、电子、中性原子/分子以及自由基组成的电离气体。在半导体工艺中，等离子体处理通过物理轰击和化学反应双重机制改变材料表面特性。其核心优势在于： - 可在常温下实现传统热处理难以达到的表面改性效果 - 能精确控制处理深度（通常在纳米级） - 可选择性改变表面化学组成而不影响体材料性能 等离子体中的活性粒子（如电子、离子、自由基）与材料表面相互作用主要通过三种方式： 1. 离子轰击(Ion Bombardment)：高能离子撞击表面可去除污染物/氧化层，同时增加表面粗糙度以改善粘附性 2. 自由基反应(Radical Reaction)：化学活性自由基与表面原子反应，引入或去除特定官能团 3. 紫外辐射(UV Irradiation)：等离子体产生的紫外线可引发表面交联或降解反应 等离子体处理改善半导体材料表面特性的技术与方法 -> 半导体表面特性改善的具体应用方向

detail.q: 等离子体工艺的核心参数应该如何优化？
detail.answer: 功率密度通常控制在0.1-10 W/cm²，过高会导致表面晶格损伤 [1]；工作压力方面，低气压（0.1-10 Pa）有利于物理溅射，中气压（10-100 Pa）促进化学反应 [1]；处理时间根据材料类型调整（硅片通常1-30分钟），需通过椭偏仪实时监控 [1]；气体组成方面，添加5-20%的Ar可增强物理清洗效果，H₂含量需<10%以防止氢脆 [1]。

blocks.title: 核心工艺参数优化
blocks.text: 等离子体处理改善半导体材料表面特性的技术与方法 -> 工艺参数的关键影响因素 -> 核心工艺参数优化 功率密度：通常控制在0.1-10 W/cm²，过高会导致表面晶格损伤 工作压力：低气压（0.1-10 Pa）有利于物理溅射，中气压（10-100 Pa）促进化学反应 处理时间：根据材料类型调整（硅片通常1-30分钟），需通过椭偏仪实时监控 气体组成：添加5-20%的Ar可增强物理清洗效果，H₂含量需<10%以防止氢脆 等离子体处理改善半导体材料表面特性的技术与方法 -> 先进等离子体表面处理技术

detail.q: XPS 在半导体表面分析中有什么作用？
detail.answer: 定量分析元素价态变化（检测限0.1 at%）[1]。

blocks.title: 表面化学分析

detail.q: EUV 光刻胶与传统光刻胶有什么本质区别？
detail.answer: EUV光刻胶与传统光刻胶存在本质差异：光子能量差异，EUV光子能量（92eV）是DUV（6.4eV）的14倍，会引发二次电子发射等复杂反应 [1]；吸收机制不同，需要含重金属（如锡、铪）的光酸产生剂（PAG）增强光子吸收 [1]；分辨率需求，必须实现<15nm线宽粗糙度（LWR）和<1nm的线边缘粗糙度（LER） [1]；灵敏度悖论，需平衡曝光灵敏度（<30mJ/cm²）与抗刻蚀性的矛盾 [1]。

blocks.title: EUV光刻胶的特殊性要求
blocks.text: EUV光刻胶在7nm以下制程中的关键挑战分析 -> EUV光刻胶的特殊性要求 EUV光刻胶与传统光刻胶存在本质差异： 1. 光子能量差异：EUV光子能量（92eV）是DUV（6.4eV）的14倍，会引发二次电子发射等复杂反应 2. 吸收机制不同：需要含重金属（如锡、铪）的光酸产生剂（PAG, Photo-Acid Generator）增强光子吸收 3. 分辨率需求：必须实现<15nm线宽粗糙度（LWR）和<1nm的线边缘粗糙度（LER） 4. 灵敏度悖论：需平衡曝光灵敏度（<30mJ/cm²）与抗刻蚀性（Etch Resistance）的矛盾 EUV光刻胶在7nm以下制程中的关键挑战分析 -> 关键性技术挑战

detail.q: EUV 光刻胶在 7nm 以下制程面临哪些技术挑战？
detail.answer:
EUV光刻胶在7nm以下制程面临以下技术挑战：

**工艺集成障碍**：刻蚀转移损失要求>85%的选择比以维持图形完整性[1]；需将随机缺陷密度控制在<0.1/cm²[1]；多重曝光对齐在套刻精度<3nm时对胶厚均匀性提出<1nm变异的苛求[1]。

**材料组分优化难题**：需开发新型聚合物骨架（如含氟聚对羟基苯乙烯）以降低LER[7]；Sn/Hf等金属含量需控制在5-20wt%以兼顾吸收率和图形保真度[7]；需匹配TMAH显影液的新型显影机制[7]。

**光子-材料相互作用控制**：EUV光刻胶的化学反应主要由二次电子触发，每个EUV光子平均产生约5个二次电子，其能量分布（0-80eV）

blocks.title: 工艺集成障碍
blocks.text: EUV光刻胶在7nm以下制程中的关键挑战分析 -> 关键性技术挑战 -> 工艺集成障碍 在7nm以下节点，EUV光刻胶面临多重工艺匹配问题： - 刻蚀转移损失：要求>85%的选择比（Selectivity）以维持图形完整性 - 缺陷控制：需将随机缺陷（Stochastic Defects）密度控制在<0.1/cm² - 多重曝光对齐：套刻精度（Overlay）要求<3nm时对胶厚均匀性（<1nm变异）提出苛求

blocks.title: 材料组分优化难题
blocks.text: EUV光刻胶在7nm以下制程中的关键挑战分析 -> 关键性技术挑战 -> 材料组分优化难题 先进EUV光刻胶采用分子玻璃（Molecular Glass）或金属氧化物（Metal-Oxide）体系： 1. 分子设计挑战：需要开发新型聚合物骨架（如含氟聚对羟基苯乙烯）以降低LER 2. 金属含量平衡：Sn/Hf等金属含量需控制在5-20wt%以兼顾吸收率和图形保真度 3. 显影兼容性：需匹配TMAH（四甲基氢氧化铵）显影液的新型显影机制

detail.q: 等离子体原子层沉积（PE-ALD）有什么优势？
detail.answer: 可在<100℃下制备高质量介电层（如Al₂O₃）[1]；表面反应自限制性确保单原子层控制[1]；台阶覆盖率可达100%（高深宽比结构）[1]。

blocks.title: 等离子体原子层沉积(PE-ALD, Plasma Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition)
blocks.text: 等离子体处理改善半导体材料表面特性的技术与方法 -> 先进等离子体表面处理技术 -> 等离子体原子层沉积(PE-ALD, Plasma Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition) 结合等离子体活性的ALD技术： - 可在<100℃下制备高质量介电层（如Al₂O₃） - 表面反应自限制性(Self-limiting)确保单原子层控制 - 台阶覆盖率(Step Coverage)可达100%（高深宽比结构）

detail.q: LayoutParser 是什么？
detail.answer: LayoutParser 是一个用于简化深度学习在文档图像分析（DIA）研究与应用中使用的开源库 [14]。其核心库提供简单直观的接口，用于应用和定制用于布局检测、字符识别及许多其他文档处理任务的深度学习模型 [14]。LayoutParser 还包含一个社区平台，用于共享预训练模型和完整的文档数字化流水线 [14]。

detail.q: LayoutParser 的核心目标是什么？
detail.answer: LayoutParser 的核心目标是让创建大规模和轻量级文档数字化流程变得更加容易 [5]。

blocks.title: 5 Use Cases
blocks.text: 5 Use Cases The core objective of LayoutParser is to make it easier to create both large-scale and light-weight document digitization pipelines. Large-scale document processing LayoutParser : A Unified Toolkit for DL-Based DIA 11 focuses on precision, efficiency, and robustness. The target documents may have complicated structures, and may require training multiple layout detection models to achieve the optimal accuracy. Light-weight pipelines are built for relatively simple documents, with an emphasis on development ease, speed and flexibility. Ideally one only needs to use existing resources

detail.q: LayoutParser 有哪些典型应用场景？
detail.answer: LayoutParser 可用于大规模文档处理，侧重精度、效率与鲁棒性，目标文档可能结构复杂，可能需要训练多个布局检测模型以达到最优精度 [5][11]。LayoutParser 也可用于轻量级流水线，面向相对简单的文档，强调开发便捷性、速度与灵活性，理想情况下只需使用现有资源，避免模型训练 [5][11]。LayoutParser 还可用于轻量级视觉表格提取器，检测表格并解析其结构，例如使用预训练布局检测模型识别表格区域，并用简单规则配对 PDF 图像中的行和列 [11]。

detail.q: Milvus 架构的主要组件有哪些？
detail.answer: Milvus 架构分为四层：访问层由一组无状态代理组成，是系统的前端和用户端点 [1]；协调服务负责向工作节点分配任务，是系统的大脑 [1]；工作节点是执行器，遵循协调服务的指令执行用户触发的 DML/DDL 命令 [1]；存储是系统的骨架，负责数据持久化，包括元存储、日志代理和对象存储 [1]。

To enhance elasticity and flexibility, all components in Milvus are stateless. detail.answer: Milvus 的混合检索通过将标量过滤与向量相似性搜索配对实现 [7]。

blocks.title: Why Milvus?
blocks.text: Why Milvus? High performance when conducting vector search on massive datasets. A developer-first community that offers multi-language support and toolchain. Cloud scalability and high reliability even in the event of a disruption. Hybrid search achieved by pairing scalar filtering with vector similarity search.

detail.q: Milvus 的架构设计与部署方式分别是什么？
detail.answer: Milvus 采用存储与计算分离的云原生设计，所有组件均为无状态，系统分为接入层、协调服务、工作节点和存储四层 [1]。部署方式包括单机部署推荐使用 Docker，生产环境建议使用集群模式 [9]。

detail.q: 向量检索的召回率受什么影响？
detail.answer: 召回率主要受索引类型和搜索参数影响 [7]。对于 IVF 索引，nprobe 参数决定搜索范围，增大 nprobe 会提高召回率但降低查询性能 [7]。对于 HNSW 索引，ef 参数决定图搜索广度，增大 ef 会提高召回率但降低查询性能 [7]。HNSW 具有高召回率但内存占用较大，IVF 内存友好但需要训练 [9][18]。

blocks.title: What are the main factors affecting recall?
blocks.text: What are the main factors affecting recall? Recall is affected mainly by index type and search parameters. For FLAT index, Milvus takes an exhaustive scan within a collection, with a 100% return. For IVF indexes, the nprobe parameter determines the scope of a search within the collection. Increasing nprobe increases the proportion of vectors searched and recall, but diminishes query performance. For HNSW index, the ef parameter determines the breadth of the graph search.
